contract_plain_english: On a rectangular or logically rectangular finite-volume grid, dimensional splitting means extending a one-dimensional high-resolution method by taking fractional one-dimensional steps along every coordinate direction in turn. The passage requires sequential directional coverage but fixes neither the direction order nor the step fractions. Its remarks about simplicity, practical effectiveness, and cases needing a fully multidimensional method are qualitative context rather than additional conclusions.
